idea-plugin.name: Phalcon Route
idea-plugin.description:
Phalcon Route is a helper plugin created to easily type your routes using a helper method like route() from phalcon named routes.

This plugin can easily be used in any PHP, Twig or Vue based files.

Key features

  • Using a route config file to read your route names for autocompletion
  • You can specify a php attribute class that can be used to check route attribute name property for the routes names.
  • Autocomplete support in selected file extensions.
  • Optionally you can select to show route path text in autocomplete. [Requires index invalidation]
  • Allows the option to select the preferred quotes used in your application
  • Allows the option to choose any file extensions as long as the particular file is associated with either PHP or Twig or Vue file type.
  • Allows the option to set your own route function name when generating routes in associated files, auto generating the entire route code automatically.

Example of content inside a config router file

<?php

// 1st. method
$route = $router->add(
    '/admin/{year:[0-9]{4}}/{month:[0-9]{2}}/{day:[0-9]{2}}/{id:[0-9]{4}',
    'Invoices::view'
);

$route->setName('invoices-view');

// 2nd. method using chain method
$router->add(
    '/admin/{year:[0-9]{4}}/{month:[0-9]{2}}/{day:[0-9]{2}}/{id:[0-9]{4}',
    'Invoices::view'
)->setName('invoices-view');

return $router

Example of content inside a controller using php Attribute route class

<?php

use App\Attributes\Route;

class HomeController extends Controller
{
    #[Route('/', name: 'home')]
    public function homeAction(): void
    {
        $this->view->pick('home');
    }
}
